blocking_prerequisites.title: Independent decision purpose and necessity
blocking_prerequisites.decided: The original allocation had a legitimate stated purpose: describe fixed Linux/GCC explicit API costs for a limited integration decision. That historical allocation is closed. Current evidence supports withholding any new execution.
blocking_prerequisites.not_decided: No new concrete adoption decision, alternative or datum-dependent action has been established beyond revisiting the same qualification or repairing missing evidence. General relevance to eventual persistence does not select a present experiment.
blocking_prerequisites.finite_prerequisite: One bounded #198 consumer/operation/lifetime contract must name the already intended consumer across invocation boundaries, caller, trigger, frequency, input and retained owned values, concrete decision and alternatives, why a new observation could change it, and why source/retained evidence cannot answer it. If no consumer is selected, record DEFER and stop; do not create a use case to justify a run.

blocking_prerequisites.title: Exact selected identities and comparison meaning
blocking_prerequisites.decided: Current analysis origin and historical candidate/original-base roles are distinct and identified. The old base has no equivalent old codec; candidate live-model versus chain is not old-codec A/B regression or isolated serialization cost.
blocking_prerequisites.not_decided: No future candidate/comparator, complete runnable source/compiler/runtime/binary bundle, callback, input, ownership pattern or invocation is selected. Retained GCC identities are not Windows/MSVC qualification.
blocking_prerequisites.finite_prerequisite: Only if blocker 1 gains an independent purpose, produce one separate identity/comparison specification tied to that decision, including exact operations and ownership, input/callback identities and environment requirements. Mark unavailable future binary/runtime identities pending; no compilation or execution is granted here.

blocking_prerequisites.title: Product-cost acceptance before new data
blocking_prerequisites.decided: Typed semantics, integrity refusal, pure/owning behavior and conservative nondefault HOLD can be stated before new data. None is a positive numerical product-cost acceptance rule. The external no-op rule has a different metric and workload.
blocking_prerequisites.not_decided: The reviewed records do not specify an actual consumer call frequency, supported workload/lifetime envelope, response-time tolerance, total memory tolerance or acceptable tradeoff from which a codec acceptance rule can be justified.
blocking_prerequisites.finite_prerequisite: Use that exact consumer/operation/lifetime contract to locate or obtain the accountable product requirement, then express its cost metric, unit, window/lifetime, workload/environment and accept/HOLD/INVALID consequence with rationale independent of measured values. A nonnumeric rule is sufficient only if it actually decides the stated cost question. If no defensible requirement exists, record absence rather than picking a threshold or measuring first.

blocking_prerequisites.title: Whole-allocation matrix, containment and stop accounting
blocking_prerequisites.decided: The old 100-call/25-second-child/600-second allocation is consumed and incompatible with the closed 8-call/3-second-active/20-second-active driver. Research resource caps do not imply useful product cost.
blocking_prerequisites.not_decided: No future complete ordered allocation counts compiles, preflight, preparation, observations, warmups, controls, failures, output, metadata, copies and post-supervision work under one global ledger.
blocking_prerequisites.finite_prerequisite: After purpose and criterion exist, one separately reviewed whole-allocation specification must enumerate every process/API/control and record order, total all resources across phases/batches, define bounded output/storage/metadata/copies, and define first-error/prefix/unknown-consumption accounting. Select no matrix or positive budget in this audit.

blocking_prerequisites.title: Metric windows and observer interference
blocking_prerequisites.decided: Normal time excludes caller destruction of the positive owned result; instrumented requested payload is not copied bytes/heap/RSS; process HWM is historical. Output/capture/postwork can disturb subsequent calls. Active limits omit final flush/fsync/close/sealing/audits.
blocking_prerequisites.not_decided: No future observer-window/interference policy maps the contemplated product decision to those partial metrics or defines acceptable disturbance and full-lifecycle accounting.
blocking_prerequisites.finite_prerequisite: For the selected consumer only, produce one window/ownership/observer map covering preparation, API return, caller destruction, formatting/pipes, copies/reads/parsing/hashing, flush/fsync/close and final audits; state which decision each metric can support and how unexplained interference blocks inference. Do not subtract assumed overhead or substitute whole-child wall for missing API time.

blocking_prerequisites.title: Real producer, supervision and evidence binding
blocking_prerequisites.decided: The implemented launch interface admits only bundled Python modes and exact fixed output. It has source checks and explicit exact-child wait-status rules under default SIGCHLD/exclusive reaper assumptions; those assumptions are not authenticated or enforced for arbitrary real workloads.
blocking_prerequisites.not_decided: Real producer admission, descendant behavior, continued exclusive reap ownership, complete real-input/output provenance and whole-runtime identity have not been qualified. A semantically valid stream cannot authenticate the producer.
blocking_prerequisites.finite_prerequisite: If a real workload is later justified, first produce a separate producer/supervision design and qualification plan stating supported platform, executable/input binding, ownership of each child/reap, expected EOF/exit behavior and complete evidence/anchor retention. Any implementation or qualification run requires its own authorized slice; neither is implied by this static audit.

Do not register an incomplete protocol, allocate study003, or edit the frozen preparation to stage permission.
